main_text.p: „sa maior, quàm illius militis, „de cuius morte cum domum „falsus ab exercitu nuncius ue„nisset, & pater eius re credita „testamentum mutasset, & „quem ei uisum esset, fecisset „heredem, essetque ipse mor-„tuus, res delata est ad Cétum-„uiros. cum miles domum re-„uenisset, egissetque in heredi-„tatem paternam? Nempe in „ea caussa quæsitum est de Iu-„re ciuili, posset'ne paternorũ „bonorum exheres esse filius, quem pater testamento ne-„que heredem, neque exhere-„dem scripsisset nominatim. Hęc Cicero. uerba autē hæc, quæ passim eo in loco adij-ciun-

page.notes: The printed „ marks at the start of each line are part of the typography and are kept. The mark in the left margin beside "quem pater" is an ornament, not text, and is not transcribed. The running head at the top right is too blurred to read; the placeholder gives only an estimated length. The paragraph and column breaks are not clear: the whole block is read as one continuous passage. The page ends mid-word at "ciun-", which keeps its printed hyphen.
